item.title: Manage Busy Spring Schedules with Simple, Nutritious Bowls
item.description: Dandy Celery provides a naturally sweet and crunchy alternative to other celeries, making it a great addition to quick and nutritious recipes like Chicken and Rice Bowls with Peanut Sauce and Greek-Inspired Power Bowls. item.title: FIFA is back in Atlanta with 100 Days till World Cup 2026 begins
item.description: FIFA World Cup 2026 is set to kick off in 100 days, and FIFA held a team workshop in Atlanta to prepare for the tournament, featuring presentations on technology, logistics, and fan experiences. The post FIFA is back in Atlanta with 100 Days till World Cup 2026 begins appeared first on The Atlanta Voice.

item.title: Scientists discover a key to staying mentally sharp in old age
item.description: SuperAgers, people over 80 with superior memories, have twice the number of young neurons as cognitively healthy adults and 2.5 times as many as people with Alzheimer's disease, suggesting that the aging brain has the capacity to regenerate. The post Scientists discover a key to staying mentally sharp in old age appeared first on The Atlanta Voice.

item.title: Art imitates life in Sheila Pree Bright’s “Footwork: Where We Gather”
item.description: "Footwork: Where We Gather" is an exhibition at the Michael C. Carlos Museum featuring photography by Sheila Pree Bright, capturing the atmosphere and people surrounding Atlanta's professional sports teams and the FIFA World Cup 2026. The post Art imitates life in Sheila Pree Bright’s “Footwork: Where We Gather” appeared first on The Atlanta Voice.

item.title: Gayle King renews deal with CBS News, ending speculation about her exit
item.description: Gayle King has renewed her contract with CBS News to continue hosting "CBS Mornings" as the network plots an overhaul of its morning show and Paramount pursues a merger with Warner Bros. Discovery. The post Gayle King renews deal with CBS News, ending speculation about her exit appeared first on The Atlanta Voice.

item.title: MARTA launches new on-demand transit service on March 7
item.description: MARTA is launching MARTA Reach, an on-demand transit service providing flexible, point-to-point shared rides in 12 zones in metro Atlanta, with the service running 18 hours a day, seven days a week, and fares starting at $2.50 on March 28. The post MARTA launches new on-demand transit service on March 7 appeared first on The Atlanta Voice.

item.title: Three Black candidates aim to break Georgia’s Secretary of State glass ceiling
item.description: Three Black Americans, Penny Brown Reynolds, Adrian Consonery, Jr., and Kelvin King, are running for the position of Georgia Secretary of State, and if elected, one of them would be the first Black person to hold the office. The post Three Black candidates aim to break Georgia’s Secretary of State glass ceiling appeared first on The Atlanta Voice.

item.title: SIAC Conference Tournament 2026: CAU Women advance with 62-52 win over Tuskegee
item.description: Clark Atlanta University women's basketball team defeated Tuskegee University 62-52 in the Southern Intercollegiate Athletic Conference tournament to advance to the semifinals. item.title: UPS Store Opens Redesigned Storefront at JA BizTown
item.description: Junior Achievement of Georgia and The UPS Store celebrated the ribbon-cutting of a newly redesigned UPS Store storefront inside JA BizTown, a simulated city designed to give sixth graders exposure to real business decisions. The post UPS Store Opens Redesigned Storefront at JA BizTown appeared first on The Atlanta Voice.

item.title: Trump fires Noem as frustrations build among White House officials, GOP lawmakers
item.description: President Trump announced on social media that he was firing Homeland Security Secretary Kristi Noem and replacing her with Oklahoma Sen. Markwayne Mullin, who will take over the position on March 31st. The post Trump fires Noem as frustrations build among White House officials, GOP lawmakers appeared first on The Atlanta Voice.
